talkwheel.jaymoskingdoms.jaymoskingdoms_: You look lost. What do you need?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.newborn.call: You! Wait, please! Everything up here is so big!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.newborn.request: I came up out of the dark and I don't know anything. Where do people live? Could you show me? I'll stay close, I promise.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.newborn.take: Come with me. I'll take you to a town.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.newborn.point: There's a town that way. Keep walking and you'll find it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.newborn.on_the_way: Is it much further? My feet keep stretching.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.newborn.go_alone: Go on ahead. The town's that way.
